priority: single-request Decode toward 100 ms/token and 10 token/s without MTP

optimistic_traffic_ceiling.assumption: Treat the covered fraction as eliminating both the history read and write, even though persisting-L2 policy is a replacement hint and cannot guarantee either behavior.

whole_kernel_ceiling.hard_bound: Even deleting all 48 causal-convolution kernels for free remains below the 0.30-ms/token admission threshold in both independent production traces. An access-policy window can affect only a subset of that time.

minimum_future_probe.graph_node_api: cudaGraphKernelNodeSetAttribute with cudaAccessPolicyWindow for the 48 causal_conv1d_silu_update_kernel nodes
minimum_future_probe.risk: Reserving 2.75 MiB leaves only 1.25 MiB of ordinary L2 and may regress projection weights, scales, and metadata. Persisting policy is a cache replacement hint, not a writeback-elimination guarantee.

decision.reason: The optimistic affected-traffic ceiling is only 0.034833 ms/token, and even impossible free removal of the complete causal-convolution kernel reaches only 0.260622-0.283672 ms/token.
decision.stop_loss_triggered: static whole-kernel and byte ceilings are both below the frozen 0.30-ms/token admission gate
decision.reopen_when: Only if the per-candidate admission threshold is deliberately lowered after larger Decode opportunities are exhausted, or if causal convolution is removed as part of a distinct fusion that demonstrates an independently quantified larger benefit.

claim_limits: This is a static and existing-production-evidence ceiling rejection, not a measured access-policy-window experiment.
The 0.034833-ms/token traffic estimate is deliberately optimistic and does not account for cache contention, policy overhead, or unavoidable dirty-line writeback.
The whole-kernel durations come from production Nsys traces whose gdn_decode.cu blob matches current main; they are upper bounds on any causal-conv-only optimization.
No MTP, buffering, extra stream, or Prefill work is included.
